title: Immune ecotypes may explain multiple myeloma outcomes missed by disease staging
desc: Researchers at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center have created a comprehensive single-cell map of the tumor immune microenvironment in multiple myeloma and its precursor conditions. The study provided insights that may explain why patients with similar diagnoses often have different disease progression, treatment responses and outcomes.
